# Historical Mission22 staged transport witnesses

These are complete browser-world archives produced by exact pre-newborn source
`9f7a4758aaabd11b0b57e89d150265c313d9a13a`, not freshly acquired current worlds.
Each byte-identical producer exports only after the unchanged original staged
regression passes all branches: staged4266, idle4853, departure3866,
successor3966. Both provenance manifests bind every producer input and blob.
The producer receipts retain the full original chronological witness.

`world-3566.v8.gz` preserves the original acquired flight input. Its current
consumer restores the entire raw world without actor repairs, then uses the
original public Save/Load boundaries. It retains exact staged waypoint clocks,
final-tail controls, public Shift departure and all successor reference/seat
assertions. Its idle branch is explicitly acquisition-only: departure3881,
firstfight3886/opponent17 with the same registered physical owner. The earlier
attempt at a full current-runtime3566 continuation failed at death3926 versus
3917; this artifact does not claim unchanged historical combat thereafter.

`world-3916.v8.gz` is the genuine whole idle branch immediately before its
original lethal turn. Current public Save/Load and full replay through4853
retain exact death3917, retained owner life227, zero browserHP, actor removal,
registry cleanup, original command28 reference release and empty passengers.
This separate witness preserves the old lethal mechanism; it does not claim
that the current natural route reaches this checkpoint.

The V8/gzip format is archival transport. Public checkpoint coverage comes from
the current maintained tests, not V8 deserialization itself. No runtime files
are replaced when the maintained witnesses execute.
